items.title: MECH-236 hippocampal z_goal-injection channel ablation (first behavioural test, re-queue of burned V3-EXQ-914)
items.note: V3-EXQ-914 (script + queue entry identical to this one) was found BURNED in the coordinator DB shortly after this session pushed the corrected script (commit 1388f40): existing_status=completed, results.outcome=FAIL, but length(manifest_bytes)=5 -- far too small to be a real manifest for this design (per_seed_rows/arm_results/interpretation would be many KB), no manifest file exists anywhere under REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/, and the DB experiments row shows claimed_by_machine=NULL/claimed_at=NULL -- meaning NO worker ever actually claimed and ran it. This reads as a phantom/corrupted completion (a bogus or test result reached the coordinator /result endpoint for this queue_id, not a genuine run), the same failure class as the reference-phantom-completion-crash-before-manifest hazard: no manifest means no real run, regardless of what the DB row says. No governance-visible evidence was affected (nothing was ever written to REE_assembly/evidence/ or claim_evidence.v1.json for this queue_id). Per EXQ versioning policy (CLAUDE.md: never silently re-run under the same ID; new letter for a re-queue), re-queued here as V3-EXQ-914a with the SAME unchanged, already-verified script and design -- this is a re-queue of a burned ID, not a design change, so no new letter-worthy edit was made to the script itself. The V3-EXQ-914 anomaly itself (how a FAIL-with-5-byte-manifest reached the coordinator with no matching claim) is flagged as unresolved follow-on -- worth a /diagnose-errors pass if it recurs, but not chased further here since it produced no evidence-registry contamination and the actual fix (a correctly queued, runnable script) is what this entry restores. IGW-20260811-231 inline retry (original auto-session reaped NO_OP with no landing evidence). This SCRIPT ALREADY EXISTED, untracked, in the shared ree-v3 checkout -- clearly substantial legitimate work product from that original session, orphaned by the NO_OP outcome rather than lost. GOV-REUSE-1: genuine_exp_count=0 for MECH-236 (claim_evidence.v1.json, 2026-08-09 lit-only), and no existing MECH-292/293 manifest (V3-EXQ-496/497/868/881) records a navigation/goal-terrain readout -- checked, not recoverable. Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): confirmed by direct source read (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py propose_trajectories, ree_core/agent.py _e3_tick) that use_mech293_ghost_probes is the ONLY code path through which current_z_goal reaches hippocampal trajectory proposals on this substrate; MECH-292/293 IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-27 per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md. No re-derive brake applies (MECH-236 has zero prior autopsies). DV-SYMMETRY: mean_resource_proximity is a per-step magnitude (continuous field reading), not a CEM-internal score and not a rank/argmax DV, so monotone-rescaling symmetry does not apply; use_mech293_ghost_probes changes WHICH candidate CEM/E3 select (a discrete selection-path change), so broadcast-additive-constant invariance does not apply either; per-seed mean aggregated via a pre-registered majority seed-fraction guards against a single-seed-layout permutation risk. Design finalised across two Step-2.5a empirical-probe iterations (both documented in the script docstring): GRID_SIZE 8->16 (size 8 saturates the local resource_field_view near-constant, no discriminating power) and anchor writes switched from a periodic cadence to a resource-proximity-gated trigger (a periodic version was measured producing a NEGATIVE proximity gap -- pulling the agent toward stale, goal-irrelevant locations). Post-fix 3-seed calibration probe: mean_resource_proximity gaps of -0.011/-0.054/+0.071 (seeds 42/43/45) -- mixed/noisy, reported honestly. Verified: validate_experiments.py --strict OK; --dry-run smoke PASS; queue-file/coordinator-DB round trip re-confirmed after the burned-ID re-queue below.

items.title: Relief/Safety Fishtank Showcase -- 664 + MECH-302/303/304 (relief-completion, cue-specific safety, contextual safety terrain) enabled for the first time in the Fishtank driver family
items.note: Diagnostic TELEMETRY showcase (claim_ids=[], experiment_purpose=diagnostic); does NOT weight governance. Follow-on to V3-EXQ-664, spawned by chip-20260811-fishtank-relief-safety-variant per the 2026-08-10 reef_ecology_strategy_affective_occupancy_review addendum (2026-08-11, chip-20260810-fishtank-affect-telemetry): that review found relief (MECH-302) and safety (MECH-303 contextual / MECH-304 cue-specific) are real, validated substrate (V3-EXQ-517c, V3-EXQ-760, V3-EXQ-763) that no Fishtank showcase driver ever enables, since each sits behind its own default-False REEConfig flag 664 never sets. This script is 664 unchanged plus those three flags -- 664's own defaults/output are untouched. GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readout (relief/safety reachability in the Fishtank driver) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- 664 and every 664-derived driver runs with all three flags False; not recoverable by reanalysis, a genuinely new manipulation -- run. Substrate readiness (2.5): MECH-302/303/304 IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md and their own dedicated experiments; claim_ids=[] so no v3_pending gate applies. Empirical confirmation (2.5a): a direct probe (instantiate REEAgent with all three flags True, step 15 ticks) confirmed agent.suffering_comparator and agent.conditioned_safety_store are real constructed objects and residue_field.safety_terrain_enabled=True at runtime, not just doc-claimed. Also discovered and corrected during 2.5a/authoring: _relief_completion_event and _conditioned_safety_signal are WRITTEN by agent.sense() but CONSUMED/CLEARED by agent.select_action() (safety_cue unconditionally every tick, relief only on the tick it fires) -- reading either AFTER select_action(), the pattern 664's _read_affect uses for every other channel, would always observe them zeroed. Fixed by capturing both immediately after sense() and before select_action() in the eval step loop (see module docstring TIMING NOTE); evaluate_safety() (MECH-303) is a stateless RBF query unaffected by this and stays at its usual post-select_action call site. Re-derive brake (2.5b): not applicable, claim_ids=[]. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): one open DEGRADING (not corrupting) entry overlaps -- SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND (residue/field.py, unbounded update_valence accumulator found growing 40-110x under sustained exposure in the V3-EXQ-906 lineage, still open/pending_implementation). Both MECH-302 relief-completion and MECH-304 safety-cue release write into that same VALENCE_LIKING accumulator via update_valence -- this run is the first config where that write path is fed by MECH-302/304 specifically. Not blocking (degrading only; this showcase's PASS criteria are not load-bearing on liking's absolute magnitude) but noted here and in the script docstring so a future reader of `liking` growth in this run's episode_log does not mistake it for a novel finding. Ethics preflight (2.6): all-false/allow, same as every other V3 Fishtank showcase -- no self-model, no autobiographical memory, harm/residue/safety streams remain pre-ethical instrumentation (SENT-0). z_goal liveness: wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator (agent built fresh per seed inside run_seed()); smoke reports 'no writer defect'. NON-DEGENERACY (the point of this run, verified two ways before queuing): (1) --dry-run smoke (tiny scale, 3 warmup + 2 eval x 30 steps, single seed) -- validate_experiments.py --strict OK, PASS, core channels non-degenerate, but relief/safety too sparse to observe at this tiny scale (expected -- MECH-302 needs a genuine sustained z_harm_a descent, MECH-304 needs a prior MECH-302 firing to seed its EMA prototype). (2) A moderate-scale local probe (single seed, 15 warmup + 5 eval x 200 steps = 4000 total steps, run outside the queued script via direct run_seed() call, no manifest written) found relief_event fired 36/518 eval steps and safety_cue_signal was clearly non-degenerate (std=0.285) -- both MECH-302 and MECH-304 confirmed genuinely reachable, not just theoretically wired. safety_terrain_read (MECH-303) stayed flat (agent.residue_field.total_safety==0, num_safety_steps==0 -- accumulate_safety() never triggered because z_harm_a norm never sustained below the default contextual_safety_harm_threshold=0.05 in this continuously-hazardous reef env across the whole 4000-step probe). Mechanism confirmed correctly wired (2.5a) but not confirmed non-degenerate at this env/threshold/scale; left at REEConfig defaults per this run's 'confirm the default operating point' scope, not tuned. Flagged as follow-on, not blocking: chip-20260811-mech303-threshold-reachability (investigate whether V3-EXQ-760's own env is calmer / whether a threshold recalibration or companion environment is needed). The full 3-seed x 50-warmup queued run has ~6.6x the step budget of the moderate probe and may still cross this bar; report honestly either way when reviewed. Separately, this driver's authoring also surfaced (and a follow-on chip was spawned for, chip-20260811-sd047-transient-hazard-reef-exclusion) an UNRELATED dormant defect in the shared env: SD-047's _step_transient_events (multi_source_dynamics_enabled + transient_events_enabled, both default False, not enabled by this driver) can spawn a hazard directly inside a reef cell because it checks only cell-emptiness, unlike _place_reef_patches and _drift_hazards which both correctly exclude _reef_cells -- does not affect this run (neither flag is set) but is a real latent gap for any future SD-047+SD-054 combination. fishtank_viz.html updated in the same session to render the three new channels (relief/safety_cue/safety_terrain bars, graceful degradation verified live in-browser against both this run's log and the pre-existing 664 log). Verified: validate_experiments.py --strict OK; --dry-run smoke PASS (x2, seeds 0 and 7); moderate-scale non-degeneracy probe as above; viz render verified live.
